correctness.rationale: For coprime multipliers, the proof constructs \(n_m=(b^m-1)/a\) and compares maximal digit sum \((b-1)m\) with a repeated proper block on the \(c\)-ray. The block has a strict per-block deficit, while subtracting a fixed quotient changes only boundedly many low blocks. This forces \(a\mid c\); symmetry forces equality. In prime base, stripping \(p\)-adic powers reduces exactly to the coprime case. The proof covers all quantified positive integers and does not infer an infinite statement from computation.
